biography: Vijayaraghavan M. Chariar works on sustainable design, traditional knowledge systems, ecological sanitation and rural housing. Trained in materials science, he combines research with community-based innovation involving farmers and artisans. His work includes waterless sanitation technologies and the Rural Housing Knowledge Network.
researchOverview: Research connects traditional ecological knowledge with sustainable design, particularly in sanitation, housing and rural livelihoods. Projects include nutrient recovery, bamboo materials, rural entrepreneurship and community well-being.
